title: Classify every SUSI_* variable as internal, test or user-facing
goal: Zero-config means zero REQUIRED files or env vars: derive, detect or default; where only the human can supply something (a secret, a consent) ask once at the moment of need, never via a hand-edited file. About 40 SUSI_* variables are read today. Classify each; user-facing ones must have a config-free default and be documented, internal/test ones must be unreachable in production paths. Tests zc_env_classify_*.
